title: Iida 2002 L4-L5 SSL+ISL elastic stiffness (degenerative surgical patients)

quantity.name: elastic stiffness
quantity.definition: slope of elastic zone of load-displacement curve

source.authors: Iida T, Abumi K, Kotani Y, Kaneda K
source.n: 24 L4-L5 SSL+ISL bone-ligament-bone complexes from 24 surgical patients
source.sample: human lumbar SSL+ISL complex, L4-L5, harvested at posterior surgery for degenerative disease (stenosis 14, spondylolisthesis 7, herniation 2, scoliosis 1)

protocol.summary: Fresh-frozen (-30 C) surgical BLB complexes with halves of the adjacent spinous processes; kept moist with Ringer's / high humidity; SSL and ISL tested combined. CSA by CCD/video dimension analyser (36 directions); initial length = shortest distance between spinous processes on X-ray under 300 g load. Uniaxial tension (MTS 858), 3 N preload, constant displacement 0.5 mm/s to failure. Stiffness = slope of elastic zone of load-displacement; modulus = slope of linear stress-strain portion.
how_to_simulate: Model the L4-L5 SSL+ISL complex between spinous processes (initial length ~9.9 mm, CSA ~185 mm2)
Apply 3 N preload, then uniaxial tension at 0.5 mm/s to failure
Report ultimate load, linear (elastic zone) stiffness, tensile strength and modulus

extraction.check_notes: Values from Results text (plus-minus signs lost in text extraction; checked against abstract: 203.2+-102.9 N, 60.6+-36.7 N/mm, 1.2+-0.6 MPa, 3.3+-2.1 MPa, CSA 185.1+-58.6 mm2, length 9.9+-4.0 mm). DOI taken from PII printed in PDF (S1529-9430(02)00142-0).

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
